name: Short Cut Apple-Cranberry Brie & Muenster Grilled Cheese Sandwich on Sourdough

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; cut into thin slices. Thinly slice brie.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 Gala apple
½ (7 oz) wheel brie cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.

While the skillet heats up, place half of the bread slices on a flat surface. Layer each with Muenster, then evenly spread with cranberry sauce; top with apple slices and brie. Close sandwiches with remaining slices of bread.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 slice sourdough bread
3 slice Muenster cheese, sliced
⅓ cup cranberry sauce, whole berry

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add 2 tsp butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Place sandwiches in the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown, 2-4 minutes. Remove the sandwiches to a plate and add another 2 tsp butter to the skillet; return sandwiches to the skillet, browned-side up, and cook until golden brown on the other side and the cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Once done, transfer to a cutting board and slice in half.
To serve, divide sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
